faqs.question: What is a JSON validator?
faqs.answer: A JSON validator is a developer tool that analyzes structured text against the official RFC 8259 JSON grammar. It verifies that keys are enclosed in double quotes, delimiters like commas and colons are properly placed, brackets and braces are balanced, and data types (objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, and null) are strictly valid.

faqs.question: How can I validate JSON online?
faqs.answer: Paste or type your raw JSON into the input editor and click 'Validate JSON'. The browser's native parser evaluates the text immediately, outputting 'Valid JSON ✓' with data statistics if valid, or pinpointing the exact error, line number, and column number if invalid.

faqs.question: Is this JSON validator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our JSON validator is 100% free with no usage limits, no credit card requirements, and no account registration needed.

faqs.question: How do I know if my JSON is valid?
faqs.answer: When you click 'Validate JSON', a clear validation status card appears. If valid, you will see a green 'Valid JSON ✓' badge alongside the detected root type, character count, line count, and payload size. If invalid, a red 'Invalid JSON ✕' badge appears with the parser error message and line coordinates.

faqs.question: Why does my JSON have a syntax error?
faqs.answer: Common causes of JSON syntax errors include missing or trailing commas, using single quotes instead of double quotes, unclosed curly braces or square brackets, unquoted object keys, or trailing comments (which standard JSON does not allow).

faqs.question: Does JSON allow single quotes?
faqs.answer: No. According to standard JSON specifications (ECMA-404 and RFC 8259), all strings and object keys must be enclosed in double quotes ("). Single quotes ('') are not valid in standard JSON and will trigger a parsing error.

faqs.question: Are trailing commas allowed in JSON?
faqs.answer: No. Unlike modern JavaScript or Python, standard JSON does not permit trailing commas after the last element in an array or the last property in an object. For example, {"item": 1,} is invalid.

faqs.question: Can this validator show where the error is?
faqs.answer: Yes. Whenever your browser's native JSON engine reports a position or line/column offset, our validator computes the exact line and column numbers and highlights the problematic line so you can immediately locate and fix the mistake.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a JSON validator and JSON formatter?
faqs.answer: A JSON validator inspects syntax to ensure text conforms strictly to JSON grammar rules and reports errors if parsing fails. A JSON formatter takes valid JSON and arranges it with customizable indentation and line breaks to make it human-readable.

faqs.question: Is my JSON uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. All JSON parsing, validation, formatting, and file generation happen entirely in your browser using client-side JavaScript. No data is ever transmitted, logged, or stored on external servers.

en.contentHtml:
JSON Validator Online

In modern web development, JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) has become the ubiquitous language for data interchange, configuration files, and RESTful API communications. However, because JSON requires strict formatting rules, a single missing comma or accidental single quote can cause an entire application or microservice to crash. An online JSON Validator provides an immediate, browser-based inspection system that evaluates your syntax against the official ECMA-404 and RFC 8259 JSON standards.

Using our json validator online, developers, system administrators, and software testers can verify whether incoming or outgoing payloads are completely syntactically valid before deployment. Rather than sending confidential payload strings over the network to external backend endpoints, this validator executes native browser JavaScript, maintaining complete privacy while delivering millisecond diagnostics.

What Is a JSON Validator?

A JSON validator is an automated diagnostic utility that takes a raw text string and attempts to parse it according to the strict grammatical specifications of JSON. Unlike tolerant programming languages like JavaScript or Python that support flexible syntax, JSON is a strict data transport format that accepts only six core primitive and composite data types:

Objects

Unordered collections of zero or more key/value pairs enclosed in curly braces {}.

Arrays

Ordered sequences of zero or more values separated by commas and enclosed in square brackets [].

Strings

Sequences of zero or more Unicode characters wrapped strictly in double quotation marks ("...").

Numbers

Standard base-10 integers or floating-point values. Hexadecimal and leading zeroes are disallowed.

Booleans

Literal lowercase values representing binary state: exactly true or false.

Null

The explicit empty value literal represented strictly by the lowercase keyword null.

If any character violates these boundaries, a JSON validator immediately catches the syntax violation, prevents transmission errors, and displays helpful error diagnostics.

How to Validate JSON

Validating complex datasets takes only seconds using the step-by-step workflow below:

1

Step 1: Paste or Type JSON

Enter your payload into the JSON Input text editor. You can also click Load Example to see a reference structure.

2

Step 2: Click Validate JSON

Press the prominent blue Validate JSON button to trigger immediate parsing through your browser's native engine.

3

Step 3: Review the Validation Result

If valid, the tool displays a green Valid JSON ✓ confirmation card alongside payload metrics such as root type and byte size.

4

Step 4: Troubleshoot Syntax Errors

If invalid, review the diagnostic panel showing the parser error message and the exact line and column where the failure occurred.

5

Step 5: Correct and Validate Again

Fix the highlighted mistake in the input editor, re-click Validate JSON, and format or download your clean file.

Common JSON Syntax Errors

Because JSON is derived from JavaScript object syntax, developers frequently make assumptions based on JavaScript's looser syntax rules. Below are the four most frequent JSON mistakes:

✕

Missing Commas

A comma is required between every key-value property and array member. Omitting a comma between keys produces a syntax error.

{
  "name": "John"
  "age": 30
}

Fix: Place a comma after "John", to separate properties.

✕

Single Quotes Instead of Double

In JavaScript and Python, single quotes are valid for strings. In standard JSON, all keys and string values must strictly use double quotes.

{ 'status': 'active' }

Fix: Replace single quotes with standard double quotes: { "status": "active" }.

✕

Trailing Commas

Placing a comma after the last property or array item is valid in modern ECMAScript, but completely invalid in standard JSON.

{
  "name": "John",
}

Fix: Delete the trailing comma after the final property.

✕

Unclosed Brackets & Braces

Every opening brace { must have a matching closing brace }, and every opening bracket [ must match a closing ].

{ "items": [ "alpha", "beta" }

Fix: Ensure brackets are correctly balanced: { "items": [ "alpha", "beta" ] }.

Valid JSON Example

Here is an example of a well-formed JSON object adhering to RFC 8259 syntax specifications:

Valid Syntax Representation Passes validation ✓ 
{
  "name": "John",
  "age": 30,
  "active": true
}

Why this is valid: All keys ("name", "age", "active") are enclosed in double quotes, properties are delimited by commas without trailing commas, values match valid primitives (string, number, boolean), and the outer braces are balanced.

Invalid JSON Example

Examining malformed JSON demonstrates how subtle syntax deviations cause parsing failures:

Malformed JSON Snippet Fails validation ✕ 
{
  name: "John",
  "age": 30,
}

Why this fails: First, the property key name is unquoted, which violates the strict JSON key grammar. Second, there is an illegal trailing comma after 30, right before the closing brace. Our validator will flag these mistakes immediately.

JSON Validator vs JSON Formatter

While developers often use validation and formatting interchangeably, each tool serves a distinct technical role in the data development lifecycle:

Feature JSON Validator JSON Formatter
Core Purpose Validates syntax correctness against RFC 8259 grammar Re-indents and styles valid JSON for human readability
Invalid Input Behavior Pinpoints exact error message, line, and column Displays parse failure alert and blocks formatting
Typical Use Case Debugging broken API responses and broken payloads Cleaning up messy minified JSON strings for documentation

Need to format valid JSON? Try our dedicated JSON Formatter to adjust indentation, beautify nested structures, or convert XML documents to JSON.

JSON Validator for API Responses

When integrating third-party APIs, microservices, or webhooks, unexpected network truncations or server-side 500 error pages returning HTML can break client parsing. A JSON Validator is essential when:

  • Inspecting API payloads: Verify whether a webhook or endpoint response is returning pure JSON rather than malformed markup or truncated strings.
  • Validating configuration files: Audit package.json, tsconfig.json, or Docker settings before committing them to source control.
  • Data migration checks: Test database export records before seeding staging or production NoSQL databases like MongoDB.
  • Testing webhooks: Confirm that webhook test payloads conform to expected syntax standards during integration testing.
Note on Semantic Validation: A JSON syntax validator proves that a document follows grammatical JSON standards. It does not certify that your payload conforms to a specific business schema (such as JSON Schema or OpenAPI definitions).

Is This JSON Validator Free?

Yes, our online JSON Validator is completely free to use. There are no daily validation caps, no software installations, and no required registrations. Whether you are inspecting a three-line configuration file or debugging a multi-megabyte API response, you can validate, format, minify, and download files at zero cost.

Is My JSON Private?

Yes. Security and data confidentiality are critical when inspecting API responses containing authorization tokens, client records, or private configurations. Our tool is built with a strictly client-side architecture:

Complete On-Device Processing Guarantee

All parsing and validation logic executes directly in your browser's JavaScript V8/JavaScriptCore engine. Your JSON payload is never transmitted across the network, never stored in Cloudflare Worker logs, and never saved on remote databases.

faqs.question: मुझे कैसे पता चलेगा कि मेरा JSON सही है?
faqs.answer: टूल तुरंत स्टेटस कार्ड दिखाता है जिसमें डेटा का प्रकार, कुल पंक्तियां, अक्षरों की संख्या और फाइल साइज का विवरण होता है।

faqs.question: सिंटैक्स एरर क्यों आता है?

faqs.question: क्या JSON में सिंगल कोट्स (' ') चल सकते हैं?
faqs.answer: नहीं। मानक JSON नियमों के तहत सभी कीज और स्ट्रिंग्स को डबल कोट्स (" ") में ही लिखा जाना अनिवार्य है।

faqs.question: क्या अंतिम कॉमा (Trailing comma) मान्य है?
faqs.answer: नहीं। ऐरे या ऑब्जेक्ट के आखिरी एलिमेंट के बाद कॉमा लगाना अवैध माना जाता है।

faqs.question: क्या यह गलती की सटीक जगह दिखाता है?

faqs.question: वैलिडेटर और फॉर्मेटर में क्या अंतर है?
faqs.answer: वैलिडेटर सिंटैक्स की वैधता की जांच करता है, जबकि फॉर्मेटर वैध कोड को सुंदर और सुव्यवस्थित बनाता है।

faqs.question: क्या मेरा डेटा सुरक्षित है?
faqs.answer: हाँ। सारी जांच सीधे आपके ब्राउज़र में होती है और कोई डेटा सर्वर पर नहीं जाता।

faqs.question: JSONバリデーターとは何ですか？
faqs.answer: データ構造が公式のJSON構文仕様（RFC 8259）に厳密に準拠しているかを検証・診断するツールです。

faqs.question: オンラインでJSONの構文チェックを行うには？
faqs.answer: コードを貼り付けるだけで、即座に構文の正当性を検証し、不備がある場合は原因を表示します。

faqs.question: JSONでよくある構文エラーは何ですか？
faqs.answer: 末尾の余計なカンマ、ダブルクォーテーションの代わりにシングルクォーテーションを使用すること、括弧の閉じ忘れなどです。

faqs.question: エラーの発生箇所（行と列）は特定できますか？

faqs.question: 個人情報や社内データの検証は安全ですか？
faqs.answer: 完全に安全です。検証処理はすべてブラウザ内でローカル実行され、外部への通信は行われません。

faqs.question: JSON Schema（スキーマ）検証に対応していますか？
faqs.answer: はい。必須フィールドやデータ型の適合性をチェックするスキーマ検証をサポートしています。

faqs.question: 軽微な構文エラーの自動修正はできますか？
faqs.answer: はい。シングルクォートの置換や末尾カンマの除去など、頻出エラーをワンクリックで自動修正できます。

faqs.question: 準拠している国際標準規格は何ですか？
faqs.answer: 国際標準であるRFC 8259およびECMA-404に準拠しています。

faqs.question: 文字数やファイル容量の制限はありますか？
faqs.answer: 実用上の制限はなく、数千行に及ぶ大規模なJSONコードもスムーズに検証できます。

faqs.question: Supporte-t-il la validation de schéma JSON ?
faqs.answer: Oui, vérification des types de champs et des structures selon les spécifications.

faqs.question: Existe-t-il une correction automatique des erreurs ?
faqs.answer: Une option permet de convertir automatiquement les guillemets simples et d'éliminer les virgules superflues.

faqs.question: Quelle norme est respectée ?
faqs.answer: Respect strict des spécifications RFC 8259 et ECMA-404.

faqs.question: Y a-t-il une limite de taille ?
faqs.answer: Non, analyse fluide même pour des fichiers volumineux.

faqs.question: Fonctionne-t-il sur smartphone ?
faqs.answer: Oui, interface réactive adaptée aux mobiles et tablettes.

fr.contentHtml:
Validateur JSON en Ligne - Validez votre JSON

Validez JSON en ligne et trouvez les erreurs de syntaxe. Assurez-vous que votre JSON est conforme a la norme RFC 8259. Ideal pour le developpement web et les tests d'API.

Comment utiliser

  1. Collez ou tapez votre JSON
  2. Cliquez sur le bouton Valider
  3. Consultez les erreurs, avertissements et suggestions

Fonctionnalites principales

  • Verification de conformite RFC 8259
  • Mise en evidence des erreurs
  • Validation en temps reel
  • Validation de schema
  • Messages d'erreur detailles

FAQ

Pourquoi la validation JSON est-elle importante?

Un JSON invalide peut casser les API et faire planter les applications. La validation detecte les problemes avant le deploiement.

Quelles sont les erreurs JSON les plus courantes?

Guillemets doubles manquants ou en trop, virgules finales ou mauvais appariement de crochets.

Qu'est-ce que RFC 8259?

RFC 8259 est la norme Internet officielle IETF pour le format d'echange de donnees JSON.

Mes donnees sont-elles securisees?

Oui, toute la validation se passe localement dans votre navigateur. Aucune donnee n'est envoyee au serveur.

faqs.question: Was ist ein JSON-Validator?
faqs.answer: Ein Prüfprogramm, das Datenstrukturen auf formale Übereinstimmung mit den offiziellen JSON-Syntaxregeln überprüft.

faqs.question: Wie überprüfe ich JSON online auf Fehler?
faqs.answer: Fügen Sie Ihren Code ein; der Validator analysiert die Eingabe in Echtzeit und meldet syntaktische Abweichungen sofort.

faqs.question: Was sind typische Fehlerquellen in JSON?
faqs.answer: Nachgestellte Kommas (Trailing Commas), einfache statt doppelte Anführungszeichen und ungeschlossene Klammern.

faqs.question: Wird die genaue Fehlerposition angegeben?
faqs.answer: Ja, Zeilennummer und Zeichenspalte werden exakt ausgewiesen, um das Problem schnell zu beheben.

faqs.question: Ist die Datenvalidierung privat?
faqs.answer: Vollständig privat: Es werden keinerlei Nutzdaten an externe Server gesendet.

faqs.question: Wird JSON-Schema-Validierung unterstützt?
faqs.answer: Ja, Struktur- und Typüberprüfungen werden zuverlässig unterstützt.

faqs.question: Gibt es eine automatische Fehlerkorrektur?
faqs.answer: Typische Tippfehler wie einfache Anführungszeichen können auf Knopfdruck repariert werden.

faqs.question: Welche RFC-Standards gelten?
faqs.answer: Konform mit den Spezifikationen RFC 8259 und ECMA-404.

faqs.question: Gibt es Größenbeschränkungen?
faqs.answer: Keine praktischen Limits für gängige Entwickler-Payloads.

faqs.question: Ist das Tool auf Mobilgeräten nutzbar?
faqs.answer: Ja, voll funktionsfähig auf allen modernen Smartphones und Tablets.

de.contentHtml:
Online JSON Validator - Validieren Sie Ihren JSON

Validieren Sie JSON online und finden Sie Syntaxfehler. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihr JSON dem RFC 8259-Standard entspricht. Ideal fur Webentwicklung und API-Tests.

Verwendung

  1. Fugen Sie Ihren JSON ein oder tippen Sie ihn ein
  2. Klicken Sie auf Validieren
  3. Sehen Sie Fehler, Warnungen und Vorschlage

Hauptfunktionen

  • RFC 8259-Konformitatsprufung
  • Fehlerstandort-Hervorhebung
  • Echtzeit-Validierung
  • Schema-Validierung
  • Detaillierte Fehlermeldungen

FAQ

Warum ist JSON-Validierung wichtig?

Ungultiges JSON kann APIs beschadigen und Anwendungen zum Absturz bringen. Validierung erkennt Probleme vor der Bereitstellung.

Was sind haufige JSON-Fehler?

Fehlende oder zusatzliche doppelte Anfuhrungszeichen, abschliesende Kommas oder falsche Klammerung.

Was ist RFC 8259?

RFC 8259 ist der offizielle IETF-Internetstandard fur das JSON-Datenaustauschformat.

Sind meine Daten sicher?

Ja, die gesamte Validierung findet lokal in Ihrem Browser statt. Keine Daten werden an den Server gesendet.

faqs.question: O que é um validador JSON?
faqs.answer: É uma ferramenta para verificar se um bloco de dados segue fielmente as regras sintáticas do padrão JSON.

faqs.question: Como validar código JSON online?
faqs.answer: Cole seu trecho de código e receba instantaneamente a confirmação de conformidade ou o detalhamento de erros.

faqs.question: Quais são os erros mais comuns em JSON?
faqs.answer: Vírgulas sobrando no final de listas, uso de aspas simples em vez de duplas e chaves não delimitadas.

faqs.question: Mostra a linha e coluna exatas da falha?
faqs.answer: Sim, o sistema indica com precisão o ponto exato da inconformidade sintática.

faqs.question: Meus dados de desenvolvimento ficam seguros?
faqs.answer: Totalmente seguros: a análise é processada no próprio navegador sem tráfego de rede externo.

faqs.question: Faz validação com JSON Schema?
faqs.answer: Sim, confere tipos de propriedades e regras estruturais.

faqs.question: Permite corrigir erros comuns com um clique?
faqs.answer: Sim, conta com recurso para higienizar aspas simples e vírgulas excedentes.

faqs.question: Qual padrão é seguido?
faqs.answer: Compatibilidade integral com RFC 8259 e ECMA-404.

faqs.question: Existe limite de linhas?
faqs.answer: Sem limitações de volume para arquivos de programação.

faqs.question: Posso usar no celular?
faqs.answer: Sim, design responsivo para smartphones e computadores.

pt.contentHtml:
Validador JSON Online - Valide seu JSON

Valide JSON online e encontre erros de sintaxe. Certifique-se de que seu JSON esta em conformidade com o padrao RFC 8259. Ideal para desenvolvimento web e testes de API.

Como usar

  1. Cole ou digite seu JSON
  2. Clique no botao Validar
  3. Veja erros, avisos e sugestoes

Principais recursos

  • Verificacao de conformidade RFC 8259
  • Destaque de localizacao de erros
  • Validacao em tempo real
  • Validacao de esquema
  • Mensagens de erro detalhadas

FAQ

Por que a validacao JSON e importante?

JSON invalido pode quebrar APIs e fazer as aplicacoes falharem. A validacao detecta problemas antes da implantacao.

Quais sao os erros JSON mais comuns?

Aspas duplas ausentes ou extras, virgulas finais ou emparelhamento incorreto de colchetes.

O que e RFC 8259?

RFC 8259 e o padrao oficial IETF da Internet para o formato de troca de dados JSON.

Meus dados sao seguros?

Sim, toda a validacao ocorre localmente no seu navegador. Nenhum dado e enviado ao servidor.

faqs.question: JSON 검증기(Validator)란 무엇인가요?
faqs.answer: 작성된 데이터가 표준 JSON 문법 규칙(RFC 8259)을 올바르게 따르고 있는지 검사하는 도구입니다.

faqs.question: 온라인에서 무료로 JSON 문법을 확인하는 방법은?
faqs.answer: 입력창에 코드를 붙여넣으면 유효성 여부와 함께 구문 오류가 실시간으로 감지됩니다.

faqs.question: JSON 작성 시 가장 흔한 문법 실수는?
faqs.answer: 마지막 항목 뒤에 불필요한 쉼표(Trailing Comma)를 넣거나, 큰따옴표 대신 작은따옴표를 사용하는 경우입니다.

faqs.question: 오류가 발생한 줄 번호와 위치를 알려주나요?
faqs.answer: 네. 구문 오류가 발생한 정확한 줄 번호와 컬럼 위치를 즉각 표시합니다.

faqs.question: 민감한 개발 데이터 검증 시 보안 문제는 없나요?
faqs.answer: 전혀 없습니다. 모든 검증 프로세스가 사용자 컴퓨터의 브라우저 로컬 환경에서만 수행됩니다.

faqs.question: JSON Schema 검증도 지원하나요?
faqs.answer: 네. 지정된 스키마에 맞추어 데이터 형식 및 필수 필드 유효성을 함께 검사할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 자동 문법 수정(Auto Fix) 기능이 있나요?
faqs.answer: 네. 작은따옴표를 큰따옴표로 바꾸거나 불필요한 끝 쉼표를 원클릭으로 정리해줍니다.

faqs.question: 어떤 공식 표준을 준수하나요?
faqs.answer: RFC 8259 및 ECMA-404 국제 표준 규격을 완벽하게 따릅니다.

faqs.question: 입력 가능한 텍스트 크기에 제한이 있나요?
faqs.answer: 실무에서 쓰이는 수만 줄 이상의 대용량 JSON 데이터도 문제없이 검증 가능합니다.

faqs.question: 모바일 스마트폰에서도 작동하나요?
faqs.answer: 네. 모바일 웹 브라우저 환경에서도 편리하게 이용하실 수 있습니다.

ko.contentHtml:
온라인 JSON 유효성 검사기 - JSON 검증

JSON을 온라인으로 검증하고 구문 오류를 찾습니다. JSON이 RFC 8259 표준을 준수하는지 확인합니다. 웹 개발 및 API 테스트에 이상적.

사용 방법

  1. JSON을 붙여넣거나 입력하세요
  2. 유효성 검사 버튼을 클릭하세요
  3. 오류, 경고 및 제안을 확인하세요

주요 기능

  • RFC 8259 준수 검사
  • 오류 위치 강조
  • 실시간 유효성 검사
  • 스키마 유효성 검사
  • 자세한 오류 메시지

FAQ

JSON 검증이 중요한 이유는?

유효하지 않은 JSON은 API를 손상시키고 애플리케이션을 충돌시킬 수 있습니다. 검증은 배포 전에 문제를 감지합니다.

일반적인 JSON 오류는?

누락되거나 추가된 큰따옴표, 후행 쉼표 또는 잘못된 괄호 쌍.

RFC 8259란?

RFC 8259는 JSON 데이터 교환 형식의 공식 IETF 인터넷 표준입니다.

데이터가 안전합니까?

네, 모든 검증은 브라우저 내에서 로컬로 이루어집니다. 서버에 데이터가 전송되지 않습니다.

faqs.question: Che cos'è un validatore JSON?
faqs.answer: Un'applicazione che esamina un frammento di testo per verificare la conformità con la sintassi formale JSON.

faqs.question: Come verificare la correttezza di un JSON online?
faqs.answer: Inserisci il codice nel riquadro e ottieni all'istante l'esito della validazione con la mappa dei nodi.

faqs.question: Quali sono gli errori sintattici più frequenti?
faqs.answer: Virgole finali in eccesso, apici singoli al posto di virgolette doppie e parentesi non bilanciate.

faqs.question: Viene indicata la riga precisa dell'errore?
faqs.answer: Sì, l'applicazione segnala riga e colonna esatte dell'anomalia rilevata.

faqs.question: I dati caricati sono protetti?
faqs.answer: Massima privacy: l'analisi è eseguita esclusivamente sul client senza trasferimenti web.

faqs.question: Supporta la validazione dello schema?
faqs.answer: Sì, verifica la coerenza di tipi e strutture in accordo con gli standard.

faqs.question: Dispone di correzione automatica?
faqs.answer: Sì, corregge automaticamente le virgolette non conformi e rimuove virgole superflue.

faqs.question: Quale standard RFC adotta?
faqs.answer: Pienamente conforme a RFC 8259 e alle specifiche ECMA-404.

faqs.question: Ci sono vincoli di capienza?
faqs.answer: Nessun limite restrittivo di caratteri.

faqs.question: Funziona su browser mobili?
faqs.answer: Sì, utilizzabile agevolmente da smartphone e tablet.

it.contentHtml:
Validatore JSON Online - Valida il tuo JSON

Valida JSON online e trova errori di sintassi. Assicurati che il tuo JSON sia conforme allo standard RFC 8259. Ideale per lo sviluppo web e i test API.

Come usare

  1. Incolla o digita il tuo JSON
  2. Clicca sul pulsante Valida
  3. Controlla errori, avvisi e suggerimenti

Funzionalita principali

  • Verifica conformita RFC 8259
  • Evidenziazione posizione errori
  • Validazione in tempo reale
  • Validazione schema
  • Messaggi di errore dettagliati

FAQ

Perche la validazione JSON e importante?

JSON non valido puo rompere le API e far fallire le applicazioni. La validazione rileva i problemi prima del deployment.

Quali sono gli errori JSON piu comuni?

Virgolette doppie mancanti o extra, virgole finali o abbinamento errato delle parentesi.

Cos'e RFC 8259?

RFC 8259 e lo standard Internet ufficiale IETF per il formato di scambio dati JSON.

I miei dati sono sicuri?

Si, tutta la validazione avviene localmente nel tuo browser. Nessun dato viene inviato al server.
